cycles.change: Batch refresh. Registry rebuilt from the TASE 'Dual Listed - Sec. Law' market-data list (52 records). The old registry claimed 43 pairs but listed 5, three of them wrong. chart.py reused the TASE symbol for the US leg and ignored per-pair ratio/threshold; it now resolves through scripts/registry.py and raises for unregistered symbols. dual_diff.py docstring example produced a 108% gap (CHKP at 145000 agorot). BoI '15:30 publication' time not found in the BoI source, removed.
